The Problem

Five apps stitched together
is not a system.

You’ve got a logger, a chatbot, a spreadsheet, and two communities. None of it talks to each other. That’s the friction killing your consistency.

⏱

Logging kills momentum

Clunky interfaces interrupt your flow. By the time you log a set, the focus and intensity you felt in that moment are already gone.

📊

Progress is invisible

You work hard every session but can’t tell if you’re actually improving. Shallow analytics bury the real signal in your data.

🤖

AI that doesn’t know you

Generic chatbots give generic advice. They don’t know your history, your plateau, your schedule, or how yesterday’s session went.

FAQ

Honest answers.

Is this beginner-friendly?+
Yes. Onboarding captures your level and goals, then sets up an appropriate starting path. You don’t need to know anything about programming — just your goals and available equipment.
Does it support advanced lifters?+
Absolutely. The analytics engine, periodization support, live muscle stimulation tracking, and AI coaching are designed for athletes who care about performance over months, not just sessions.
Does AI replace a real personal trainer?+
No — and we won’t claim it does. The AI coach gives context-aware recommendations and plans based on your real data. Not a substitute for human expertise, but far more useful than any generic chatbot or static program.
Is my data private?+
Yes. All data is private by default. You control visibility for all social features. We use JWT auth, Zod input validation, HTTPS, Helmet, CORS, and rate limiting across the entire API stack.
Can I track body progress too?+
Yes — weight log, body measurements, and a progress photo timeline are all built in. One continuous view instead of three separate apps.
Can I use FlexAI without social features?+
Fully. Social is opt-in. If you want pure training tracking, AI coaching, and analytics in private mode, that’s a completely supported way to use the app.
How is FlexAI different from other apps?+
Most apps solve one problem — logging, or AI chat, or analytics — but in silos. FlexAI is an integrated system where every module shares context. Your coach knows your sessions. Your analytics reflect your full history. Nothing lives in isolation.
